summary.ru: Голландская Гвинея — колония Нидерландов с 1637 по 1871 год, в основном на территории современной Ганы. Столица — Эльмина.
summary.en: The Dutch Gold Coast or Dutch Guinea, officially Dutch possessions on the Coast of Guinea, was a portion of contemporary Ghana known as the Gold Coast, that from 1612 was gradually colonised by the Dutch West India Company from the Dutch and Batavian Republics (present-day Kingdom of the Netherlands). The Dutch began trading in the area around 1598, joining the Portuguese which had a trading post there since the late 15th century.
